hypothesis: A builder-first hook brings more relevant trials than a demo-first hook
planned_comparison: launch-a versus launch-b with the same clip and destination
primary_signal: Completed external runs with source and output
confounders: Different audience time and reach; organic sequential posts are not randomized
decision_rule: Prefer the hook associated with useful conversations and completed runs; report low sample uncertainty

hypothesis: A demo-first hook is clearer than three unanswered buyer questions
planned_comparison: Winning working hook versus launch-c; same media and destination
primary_signal: Specific replies explaining the product correctly
decision_rule: Inspect actual misunderstandings before selecting the next hook

hypothesis: A one-hero audit is easier to start than a whole-page rewrite
planned_comparison: One-hero task versus full-page task on a permitted brief
primary_signal: Observed completion or first blocked step
confounders: Different source complexity and users; no elapsed-time benchmark assumed
decision_rule: Narrow the quick start if the broad task repeatedly blocks real users

hypothesis: A same-facts same-design clip makes differences easier to inspect than a generic demo
planned_comparison: 27-second comparison versus readable three-pitch still; same copy
primary_signal: Qualified replies or observed completed runs
decision_rule: Keep the asset that supports useful inspection; do not infer conversion lift

hypothesis: Founder-owned cases can drive voluntary independent sharing
planned_comparison: Consented founder case versus authored fixture; never require sharing
primary_signal: Independent share with a real case and subsequent reported trials
decision_rule: Repeat only with permission and sustainable time per case
